name: centry-family-office-planner
description:
Build an international ownership picture, preserve original currencies and ownership shares, compare manually recorded estate intentions, and organise property chronology, family handover, gifts and specialist requirements. Reviews supplied facts and documents without determining legal validity or claiming provider matching.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

Recorded intentions are not authenticated wills. No succession-law, tax, professional matching or transfer conclusion. Unconverted native amounts remain separate. No legal-validity, succession-law or tax determination. No verified provider directory is connected; no matching or market-wide comparison. Text and table review only; no OCR, registry, account or original-document authentication. Native values and optional dated FX rates are user assumptions; unconverted values are never silently aggregated. Comparisons use manually entered estate rows with referenced text; document text is not semantically authenticated.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release of Centry Global Estate Planner: Build an international ownership picture, preserve original currencies and ownership shares, compare manually recorded estate intentions, and organise property chronology, family handover, gifts and specialist requirements. Reviews supplied facts and documents without determining legal validity or claiming provider matching. Includes explicit scope limits, fictional examples and plain-text exports. Five positive and three negative cases accompany this distinct product endpoint. No account or payment is required for the planning utility.
